fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2007, for every one-cent change in the cost per gallon of jet fuel, Hawaiian's annual fuel expense will increase or decrease by approximately $1.3 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: OTC jet fuel forward contracts with single counterparty. Fixed prices $1.85-$2.03/gallon. As of Feb 2, 2007: Q1 2007 13,346k gal (44%), Q2 7,434k gal (23%), Q3 1,218k gal (4%), Q4 252k gal (1%). Total ~22.25M gallons hedged. Fair value -$1.1M (liability) at Dec 31 2006.

warnings: Volume table reflects positions as of Feb 2, 2007 (includes actual January 2007 hedging); no full-year 2006 pct hedged disclosed; gallons in thousands converted to millions
